notes.title: Added Traditional Chinese support
notes.content:
To yuri fans in Taiwan and Hong Kong; thank you for your patience and we would like to announce that "Yumeutsutsu" series is now officially supporting [b]Traditional Chinese[/b]!


For those who weren't able to play the game due to the language barriers, you can now enjoy it without any issues. Please take this chance and give it a try or spread the words to your friends so they can fully enjoy bubbly-cute girls love adventure game about game developers in [b]Yureka Soft[/b]!

notes.title: Korean language update
notes.content:
To yuri fans in Korea; thank you for waiting so long! Korean language support has now been added.
If you were interested in "Yumeutsutsu" but weren't able to play the game due to the language, please enjoy bubbly-cute girls love adventure game about game developers in Yureka Soft!

notes.title: Issue with nonsense text in savedata fixed for simplified Chinese language
notes.content:
A small update has been pushed for those playing this title in simplified Chinese. When saving progress, the savedata description was displaying a random assortment of nonsense characters due to a display issue. This issue has been fixed, and there should no longer be any nonsense characters showing in savedata descriptions.

Thanks for your continued support, everyone!

notes.title: Alt+Tab crashes fixed
notes.content:
One more small update: you are now able to Alt+Tab out of and back into this game when running in fullscreen mode without crashing.

Thanks for your continued support, everyone!

notes.title: Various display-related bugs fixed
notes.content:
A new bugfix has been pushed to address the following issues:
[list]
[*]Only Japanese-version video files play during the game
(Partially fixed in last patch, but all proper videos should now consistently play for English- and Chinese-language setups.)
[*]Fullscreen setting does not save across gameplay sessions
(You should now properly restart in fullscreen if you exited the game in fullscreen.)
[*]Exiting the game in fullscreen mode causes it to automatically restart in windowed mode
(This should no longer occur for any users.)
[/list]

The issue with Alt+Tab from fullscreen crashing the game is still present, but is being looked into by the developers, so a solution should be available sometime in the near future.

Thanks for all your patience and support, and we hope you continue to enjoy the Yumeutsutsu experience!

notes.title: Yumeutsutsu Re:Master & Re:After playable in English and Chinese on April 23rd!
notes.content:
Visual novel and girls’ love fans, rejoice! English and Chinese support for the yuri adventure novel [i]Yumeutsutsu Re:Master[/i], as well as the multi-lingual release of its extended epilogue, [i]Yumeutsutsu Re:After[/i], are both ready to invade your PCs on April 23, 2020!

[i]Yumeutsutsu Re:Master[/i] has been available for Windows PC in Japanese only since July 2019, but will be receiving a worldwide update that adds English and Chinese text on April 23rd. Simultaneously with this, the expanded final chapter of the story, [i]Yumeutsutsu Re:After[/i], will be made available worldwide, playable in English, Chinese, or the original Japanese.

From the creators of [i]Nurse Love Addiction[/i] and [i]Nurse Love Syndrome[/i], the [i]Yumeutsutsu[/i] saga (the word itself roughly translating as a half-awake, half-asleep dreamlike state) tells the story of a country girl, Ai, who moves to the big city in order to get closer to her estranged game developer sister, Kokoro. The relationship between the two proves more strained than Ai expected, however, and the people she meets in the big city prove far stranger (and perhaps deadlier?) than she could’ve ever imagined. (If you think you know what to expect from this game, then you don't know Kogado visual novels!)

On top of that, the game that Kokoro’s been developing – and which Ai is now also tasked with working on – is a remake of an indie game from their past, which holds significance for them both and may unlock some long-sealed memories...

Once you’ve completed the main story in [i]Yumeutsutsu Re:Master[/i], you can expand upon it with character-centric vignettes through this extended final chapter, [i]Yumeutsutsu Re:After[/i].

Come join the adventure on April 23rd, and experience love, loss, and life at Eureka Software!

See here for the Yumeutsutsu Re:Master page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1058140/Yumeutsutsu_ReMaster/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1058140/Yumeutsutsu_ReMaster/[/url]
